cuts: 17 deterministic cuts at 0/16 through 16/16 of mixing iterations

models.full_checkpoint: fixed reserve plus bitmap-ranked values for every materialized word at the cut
models.naive_snapshot_delta: immutable full checkpoint plus every distinct word written after the cut
models.optimistic_staged: one reusable bitmap-ranked store sized to the larger of exact offline capture and resume live frontiers during forward execution without recursive regeneration

interpretation: registers and accumulator alone are never an exact resumable checkpoint because later addresses read historical scratch values
full and snapshot-delta models are executable representation costs but this screen does not execute them
the optimistic staged model grants perfect future knowledge and free scheduling, so failure to fit is adverse evidence
a fitting optimistic cut would not establish an executable attacker or pass a gate
one checkpoint cannot remove the workload's global live-value maximum; exact recursive regeneration is required when that floor exceeds the ceiling
